text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Christian Maronite Patriarch Sfier says: "I do not see any problem if Syrian troops leave Lebanon."
- U.S. State Department report recognises improved security situation in Lebanon.
- Israeli shelling of areas in western sector of south Lebanon.
- Independence of Constitutional Council is not debatable, Prime Minister Hariri says after opposition accusation that government interferes in high court's affairs.
- Israel plans to supply Lebanese militia allies with sophisticated weapons to deter guerrilla attacks on Israel's southern occupation zone.
- 26 of the 46 released Lebanese hostages in Zaire arrive in Beirut.
